name: GoldenCoinsMsg
meaning: Messages GoldenCoins (class 141) handles, as used by Sam_Pirate. Handler 0x4c7cde read for meaning.

name: MSG_QUERY_ACTION
meaning: 4 CTX_PICKUP for the Wolf unless claimedBySam (+0x70)

name: MSG_QUERY_NEAREST_TARGET
meaning: fills {u16 classIcon 0x8d; u16 level} for the Wolf's HUD hint (+0x660), from the nearest visible coin within 600 or Sam's distance (0x4a84)

name: MSG_DETECTOR_PING
meaning: from MineDetector_ConeScoreCB 0x4d7d00: a buried coin (state 0) gets revealed = 1 and state 3 (the coin answers 1 in every state)

name: MSG_COIN_IS_TAKEN
meaning: returns 0 only when state 2 and inInventory (+0x6c, msg 7/8) == 0; +0x70 is the Sam claim
